plant.name: Isakhiwo sezimboni
plant.intro: Izici zamapayipi, ama-isometric, izinto zenqubo ezinamakhanetho nokuhlolwa kwesakhiwo. Isisekelo sokudweba, hhayi ukuvunywa kwezobunjiniyela: umuntu ophethe isakhiwo uyanikezela izici, imikhawulo nemidwebo.
equip.intro: Izinto ezijwayelekile ezinobukhulu obufanele, ezinamakhanetho (azinazo izilinganiso zomenzi). Engeza lokho isakhiwo sinakho; uhlu lugcinwa kulesi siphequluli futhi luphuma njengefayela le-IFC ngephoyinti kwikhanetho ngalinye.
specs.intro: Isici sitholakala ngempahla nangesigaba somugqa. Lezi zifika nge-add-on; usayizi nezindonga zivela kumathebula avulelekile.
iso.intro: Khetha imigqa yamapayipi emodeli, bese ulondoloza i-isometric yayo: ukuhlelwa kwe-30°, yonke ingxenye ilinganiswe, amazinga okuphakama, ama-valvu, izindawo zokushisela nohlu lwezinto. Akulingani nesikali.
layout.intro: Hlola uhlu lwezinto olungenhla, nezinto ezibekwe kumodeli usuka kumtapo, ukuthi zingqubuzana yini, izindlela, indawo edingekayo ecaleni kwento ngayinye nomthwalo wophansi. Imikhawulo ingeyakho.
cmd.spec-check: Hlola imigqa ekhethiwe ngezici zayo zepayipi
err.noruns: Khetha imigqa yamapayipi eyodwa noma ngaphezulu kuqala.
need.write: Ukubeka izinto emodelini evulekile nokuhambisa umugqa phakathi kwamakhanetho kudinga i-BimCraft add-on API 1.1, ongakabi khona kule bhilidi. Londoloza izinto njengefayela le-IFC bese uyivula okwamanje.
note.write.yes: Le BimCraft ingabhala emodelini: ukubeka nokuhambisa kuyatholakala.
layout.aisle: I-{a} ne-{b} zihlukaniswe ngama-{gap} mm; indlela encane kakhulu ngu-{min} mm.
layout.blocked-access: {name}: uhlangothi lwe-{side}ludinga ama-{clear} mm avulekile, kodwa i-{by} isendleleni.
layout.floor-load: I-{name} ilayisha iphansi ngo-{load} kg/m²; umkhawulo ngu-{limit}.
done.place: Okungu-{n} kubekwe emodelini: isinyathelo esisodwa sokuhlehlisa.
done.place.none: Akukho okubekwayo: yonke into kutheyibhela seyisemodelini.
route.intro: Khetha amaphoyinti amabili emodelini nesici: umelelisi uthola indlela evulekile phakathi kwawo ephuma ikhanethi ngayinye iqonde phambili, igweme izinto zetheyibhela ezisemodelini, futhi igoqe kancane kangangoba kungenzeka.
route.few: Imodeli inamaphoyinti ambalwa kunamabili okuhambisa phakathi kwawo. Beka izinto ezinamakhanetho kuqala.
route.found: Indlela ende ka-{len} mm enamagxobo angu-{bends} namawa avundlile angu-{climbs}.
route.err.blocked-start: Ikhanethi yokuqala ibheke into thile: akukho sikhala sokuphuma kuyo.
route.err.blocked-end: Ikhanethi yesibili ibheke into thile: akukho sikhala sokufika kuyo.
route.err.no-route: Ayikho indlela evulekile etholakele phakathi kwalawa maphoyinti.
route.err.too-big: Indawo inkulu kakhulu ukuthi isesho; sondeza amaphoyinti amabili.
route.err.axis: Ikhanethi kufanele ibheke ngokuqondile ku-X, Y noma Z.
route.nowrite: Ukufaka umugqa emodelini kudinga umbhali womugqa ku-API yezengezo ye-BimCraft, ongakabi khona kule bhilidi. Amaphoyinti ngamagumbi endlela ku-millimitha yesitezi sawo (inombolo yokugcina ukuphakama ngaphezu kwezinga).
route.hint: Vula ithebhu yesakhiwo, khetha amaphoyinti amabili bese ucindezela Thola indlela.
iso.bom.title: UHLU LWEZINTO
iso.note.dims.ftin: Izilinganiso ziyizinde ngomugqa ophakathi kwepayipi, ngamayadi nangamayintshi
iso.note.dims.mm: Izilinganiso ziyizinde ngomugqa ophakathi kwepayipi, ngamamillimitha
spec.starter.cs40.name: Insimbi yekhabhoni, Sch 40, insebenzo ejwayelekile
spec.starter.cs40.notes: Ipayipi elishiselwe nelinamazinyo; amahlaka amafushane kuze kube yingxenye yesine yekhanda.
spec.starter.cs80.name: Insimbi yekhabhoni, Sch 80, udonga olujiyile
spec.starter.cu-l.name: Ithyubhu lethusi, uhlobo L
spec.starter.pvc40.name: I-PVC, Sch 40
spec.starter.pex9.name: Ithyubhu le-PEX, SDR 9
cmd.route.draw: Dweba indlela etholwe ekugcineni njengomugqa wepayipi
route.drawn: Kudwetshwe umugqa we-{spec}, ubukhulu {size}, ude ngu-{len} mm, njengoshintsho olulodwa. Hlehlisa uwuthathe.
route.err.storey: Amaphoyinti omabili kufanele abe esitezini esifanayo ukuze kudwetshwe umugqa.
route.draw.note: I-BimCraft alinayo uhlelo lwenqubo lwalo: umugqa ungena kuhlelo lwamapayipi oluwukhethile, ngempahla nesigaba se-spec. Iziphetho zawo zihlanganiswa namakhanetho athintayo.
proc.intro: Layisha imodeli yenqubo (process.json) eyenziwe ku-CadCraft, ku-Super noma ngumsizi; bese uhlola imigqa yamapayipi ngayo: usayizi wemigqa, ubude, amagxobo nama-valvu anikeza ijubane lomugqa ngamunye nokwehla kwengcindezi, futhi konke okufanele i-P&ID ikushintshe kuyadubulwa.
proc.err.none: Akukho modeli yenqubo elayishiwe. Layisha i-process.json kwisigaba semodeli yenqubo.
proc.err.file: Lelo fayela alisiyo imodeli yenqubo ye-CadCraft.
done.proc: Imigqa engu-{lines} isibalwe, engu-{linked} isixhunyiwe kusha. Amaphutha angu-{errors}, izexwayiso ezingu-{warnings}. {first}
proc.edit: {ln}: ipayipi lingu-{size}, ijubane {v} m/s, ukwehla {dp} bar
proc.nolayout: Le modeli yenqubo inayo ukwakheka kwe-3D.
proc.layout.added: Izinto ezingu-{n} zengeziwe etheyibhelini; zibeke ngoBeka izinto.
wire.in: Imodeli yenqubo ifikile: umugqa {what} ungu-{size}. Imigqa yamapayipi engu-{n} ihlukile kusayizi we-P&ID.
wire.out: Umugqa {ln} manje ungu-{size} ku-3D. Imodeli yenqubo ibuyekeziwe yathunyelwa ku-P&ID.
wire.applied: Imigqa yamapayipi engu-{n} yashintshelwa kusayizi we-P&ID (isinyathelo esisodwa sokuhlehlisa).
wire.in.model: Imodeli yenqubo ifikile ({what}). Imigqa yamapayipi engu-{n} ihlukile kusayizi we-P&ID.
sec.p4: Isakhiwo namapayipi, ishejuli yamabhetshi, amanani aphilayo
p4.place.intro: Faka ukwakheka kwemodeli yenqubo emodelini: izinto, bese ipayipi ngalinye lihanjiswa phakathi kwamakhanetho ezinto. Isinyathelo esisodwa sokuhlehlisa ngakunye.
p4.place.done: Kubekwe izinto ezingu-{equipment}, kudwetshwe imigqa yamapayipi engu-{runs}, kushiywa engu-{skipped}.
p4.why.nowrite: Le BimCraft ayikwazi ukudweba amapayipi okwamanje.
p4.batch.intro: Bonisa iresiphi yebhetshi ephaneli ye-4D: isinyathelo ngasinye ngumsebenzi endaweni yezinto zayo, otholakala emodelini ngethegi yawo.
p4.batch.no4d: Vula ithebhu ye-4D kuqala: ishejuli iyoya khona.
p4.batch.done: Imisebenzi engu-{tasks}, amahora angu-{hours}, ithunyelwe ephaneli ye-4D.
p4.live.intro: Izilinganiso njenge-CSV enomugqa wekhanda tag,time,value,quality. Izinto ezinalelo thegi lilodwa zibonakala embonweni we-3D ngombala ngokwesimo sazo.
p4.live.done: Amanani angu-{n} afundiwe, izakhi ezingu-{matched} zidayiwe ngombala.
p4.live.note: Ukufunda kuphela. Lapha ayikho into elawula izinto, futhi lapha akulona uhlelo lwezexwayiso.
live.lede: Bonisa izilinganiso zesitshalo noma sakhiwo esisemdwebeni. Ukufunda kuphela: akukho lapha okubhalela idivayisi noma okukhulumisa i-alamu. Idivayisi ekheli elisesidlangalaleni idinga ukuvuma kwakho kulowo mphathi.
live.check.done: Amathegi {tags} kumadivayisi {devices} ahlolwe: izinto {problems} okufanele uzibheke.
live.bridge.none: Ukufunda idivayisi kudinga i-CadCraft Studio: ikhasi lesiphequluli alikwazi ukuvula uxhumo lwesitshalo. Sebenzisa i-CSV yezilinganiso okwamanje.
live.note: Idatha yesitshalo nesakhiwo efundwayo kuphela, yokubuka nokuqhathanisa. Hhayi uhlelo lwe-alamu noma umsebenzi wokuphepha.
timer.lede: Gcina iseshini ye-HAZOP ngesikhathi. Setha amaminithi endodeni ngayinye, qala iwashi endodeni ethi ithimba liyixoxayo, uqhubeke uma isiqedile. Isikhathi esedlule siyabonakala, asiphoqwa.
timer.none: Asikho inodi okwamanje. Dweba umngcele wenodi nge-PIDNODE kuqala.
timer.note: Usizo lokufunda eqenjini. Ibhalela isikhathi; ayinqumi ukuthi inodi iqediwe.
opt.lede: Zama izilungiselelo eziningi zemodeli yenqubo bese uzihlela. Qamba iyunithi nepharamitha okuzoshintshwa, uhla lwayo, nokuncishiswa. Amakhompyutha oxhume kuStudio (Izilungiselelo, Ukuveza, amanye amakhompyutha) nawo axazulula okuhlukile; okunye kuxazululwa lapha.
opt.nonodes: Akukho kompyutha omunye oxhunyiwe: yonke ukuhluka kuxazululwa lapha.
opt.nomodel: Akukho modeli yenqubo okwamanje. Yiletha kuqala kusuka efayelini lenqubo.
opt.done: Okuhlukile okungu-{n}: {remote} kuxazululwe kwamanye amakhompyutha, {local} lapha, {failed} akukwazanga ukuxazululwa.
opt.none: Akukho kuhluka okuhlangabezane nawo wonke amakhawulo.
